decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API extends the firm's existing messaging platform at little marginal cost, and it has been presented steadily for two years, so the option is cheap to keep open while its integration value with other channels plays out.
Launched only in 2024 and built on existing email and SMS infrastructure, the email-to-SMS gateway's value is still uncertain, and keeping it costs little, so abandoning it now would be premature.

The SMS-to-email gateway complements the other SMS products and shares their infrastructure, and with only one year of evidence and low carrying costs, real options reasoning favors keeping it until more results come in.
